_llm_instructions: Fill in the 'project_title' and 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' property of each field, based on the provided project context. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.
form_name: Flow Metrics and Value Stream Dashboard

f01_Value_Stream_Name_and_Definition.label: Value Stream Name and Definition
f01_Value_Stream_Name_and_Definition.guidance: The specific customer value stream, delivery pipeline, or product domain monitored by this flow dashboard.

f02_Measurement_Window_and_Interval.label: Measurement Window and Interval
f02_Measurement_Window_and_Interval.guidance: The operational reporting period, iteration window, and rolling sample interval evaluated for flow metrics.

f03_WIP_Limits_and_Work_Categorization.label: WIP Limits and Work Categorization
f03_WIP_Limits_and_Work_Categorization.guidance: Configured Work in Progress (WIP) caps across workflow stages and item type breakdown (Features, Defect Fixes, Technical Debt, and Risks).

f04_Lead_Time_and_Cycle_Time_Percentiles.label: Lead Time and Cycle Time Percentiles
f04_Lead_Time_and_Cycle_Time_Percentiles.guidance: 50th, 85th, and 95th percentile delivery times from work commitment to customer deployment, highlighting predictability.

f05_Flow_Efficiency_and_Wait_Time_Ratio.label: Flow Efficiency and Wait Time Ratio
f05_Flow_Efficiency_and_Wait_Time_Ratio.guidance: Percentage of total lead time spent in active value-adding touch work versus idle queue/blocking states.

f06_Throughput_and_Delivery_Velocity.label: Throughput and Delivery Velocity
f06_Throughput_and_Delivery_Velocity.guidance: Completed work items delivered per iteration cycle, indicating steady-state system capacity and throughput stability.

f07_Flow_Load_and_Work_Age_Health.label: Flow Load and Work Age Health
f07_Flow_Load_and_Work_Age_Health.guidance: Inventory of active in-flight items, aging WIP items exceeding the 85th percentile threshold, and systemic work overload.

f08_Bottleneck_Identification_and_Root_C.label: Bottleneck Identification and Root Cause
f08_Bottleneck_Identification_and_Root_C.guidance: Specific workflow stage where work accumulates as queue inventory and the underlying process constraint.

f09_Kaizen_Flow_Optimization_Action.label: Kaizen Flow Optimization Action
f09_Kaizen_Flow_Optimization_Action.guidance: Targeted continuous improvement action, WIP constraint adjustment, or dependency unblocking intervention to improve flow.
